notes: [P1] behaviour/edge: the 40px HUD bar is drawn over the board's top row, and clickHud takes every click with y < HUD_HEIGHT. mousemove also clears hover there. So the top 40px of row 0 can no longer be clicked to place a tower or show a hover. The cells can still be reached below y=40 only if TILE > 40, and any ghost or tower in that strip is drawn under the 0.78-alpha bar. Neither brief asked for this change in placement. The artboard may intend an overlay, but I could not check that from here because only the diffs are present. Either confirm it against design/screens/Main.dc.html or reserve canvas height for the bar.

[P1] missing test: src/main.js wiring has no direct test. The brief asks that clicks on the buttons and the P/F keys toggle pause and speed. The tests prove clickHud and keyHud on their own, but nothing checks that main.js calls clickHud before placeTower, or that keydown passes event.repeat through.

[P2] construction/style: keyHud runs on every keydown even when state.status is not 'playing', so P and F still toggle paused and speed on a finished round. restart() resets both, so nothing breaks, but it is an inconsistent contract next to the click handler, which only acts in play.

[P2] structure: the measuring() stand-in in render.js changes the real ctx.font while it measures, and hudText sets fillStyle on the stand-in object. It is safe inside save/restore, but the double-layout trick is fragile. A pure width calculation would be simpler.
